symbols.name: saving parameter
symbols.meaning: A fixed number greater than 0 that sets the size of the saving in the bound.
symbols.quote: A power saving in the logarithmic factor is a worst-case time bound $n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa}$ for multiplying two $n$-bit integers, where $\kappa$ is a fixed number with $\kappa > 0$ that sets the size of the saving.

relations.quote: A power saving therefore undercuts the [Schonhage-Strassen optimality conjecture](schonhage-strassen-conjecture.md), since the conjecture says no multitape machine has a time bound of smaller order than $n\lg n$.
